root_preflight.production_note: The production blobs of the candidate 025146b are unchanged: the follow-up is a test only correction inside the seven allowed files.
root_preflight.resolution: A third, distinct dynamic subcase was added inside the same node id (test_n10_r10_...): a transparent gate wraps the production wait of the worker, it calls the original wait and holds the endpoint between that wait and the recheck of its generation; the fault is published independently, the specific outcome of the named generation is waited for, the effective timeout is advanced afterwards and the endpoint is released.  The order publication -> timeout -> consumption is recorded and asserted with the current generation.
root_preflight.summary: The dynamic schedule of the M09 obligation decided the effective timeout FIRST and published the fault from cancel_synchronous_io DURING the timeout coordination; the distinct order "the fault is ALREADY published and the effective timeout arrives BEFORE the endpoint consumes the outcome" was not driven.
